verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents IMAP/SMTP compatibility, letting any standard mail client (Outlook, Thunderbird, Apple Mail) connect to an AgentMail inbox, which supports the open-protocol reachability part of the story. However, there is no mention of JMAP support or of a standards-based export/data-portability mechanism for migrating mail elsewhere. Missing for 10: JMAP protocol support, documented mailbox/data export or migration tooling, and independent confirmation that IMAP/SMTP access works reliably in practice.
